_meta.title: EN sound morphological fold — variant→lemma map (#61, Task 4)
_meta.status: PROPOSED. The SOUND sibling of en_color_variants_61.json (the colour fold). Wiring: trait_labelers sound path + linegrain_law_60 shared claim-match consult this as DATA.
_meta.law: INFLECTION (verbal + plural: -s/-es, -ing, -ed) = rule-generated standard morphology (the rule IS the citation); DERIVATION (-er/-y/-ish/-le) = admitted ONLY on a cited WordNet-'+' or Wiktextract attestation (hand-authored rows FORBIDDEN — her rule). Every row source-tagged. Un-attested candidates DROPPED. NO sound flag-class exists, so every variant folds to a CLEAN sound lemma.
_meta.difference_from_colour_fold: colour folds ADJECTIVE inflection (-er/-est) and EXCLUDES -ing/-ed; sound folds VERBAL inflection (-ing/-ed/-s) because sound bases are nouns/verbs — -ing is the 'clacking' target the colour fold excluded.
